zh:
• 首次修改旧 Equation Lab 编号时，写回前说明全文转换范围并请求确认。
• 切换公式、文件和编辑模式时保护草稿，恢复时保留公式、编号设置和编辑模式。
• 按需生成文档公式缩略图，修复缩放后标尺拖动跳位和圆角框导出失真。
en:
• Explains the document-wide conversion before the first numbering change in a document with legacy Equation Lab fields and asks for confirmation.
• Protects drafts when switching equations, files, or edit modes and restores the equation, numbering settings, and edit mode.
• Generates document thumbnails on demand and fixes ruler drag jumps and rounded borders in exports.
